name: game_findings
body: Confirmed: screenshot shows target 10x10 white top and purple bottom, canvas central upper purple and lower white, toolbar white and purple. MOUSE(x39,y5) changes upper section to white; MOUSE(x45,y5) changes upper purple. RIGHT/LEFT/UP/DOWN reshape upper arch (different angular triangular outlines); SPACE applies small changes in lower piece, sometimes 16 pixels diagonal. After many SPACE game over; RESET restores initial layout without restarting run. Need strategize lower painting. At step101 reset state upper purple lower white, toolbar purple selected. Need test: choose purple and SPACE immediately; inspect changed coords and effects. Aim produce exact goal perhaps lower needs purple + upper white and then SPACE.
